verses.text: Israel's sons were Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,
as well as Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
Judah's sons were Er, Onan, and Shelah, born to him by Shua's Canaanite daughter. Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in the LORD's sight, and the LORD put him to death.
Judah's daughter-in-law Tamar gave birth to Perez and Zerah. Judah had five sons in all.
Perez's sons were Hezron and Hamul.
Zerah had five sons: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara.
Carmi's son was Achar, who brought trouble on Israel by taking what had been set apart for destruction.
Ethan's son was Azariah.
Hezron's sons were Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.
Ram was the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab was the father of Nahshon, a leader of the people of Judah.
Nahshon was the father of Salma, and Salma was the father of Boaz.
Boaz was the father of Obed, and Obed was the father of Jesse.
Jesse's firstborn son was Eliab, his second was Abinadab, and his third was Shimea.
His fourth son was Nethanel, and his fifth was Raddai.
His sixth was Ozem, and his seventh was David.
Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. Zeruiah had three sons: Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.
Abigail gave birth to Amasa, whose father was Jether the Ishmaelite.
Caleb son of Hezron had children with his wife Azubah and with Jerioth. Her sons were Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
After Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath. She bore him Hur.
Hur was the father of Uri, and Uri was the father of Bezalel.
Later, at sixty years old, Hezron married the daughter of Machir, who was Gilead's father. He slept with her, and she bore him Segub.
Segub was the father of Jair, who had twenty-three towns in the land of Gilead.
Geshur and Aram took Jair's towns from them, along with Kenath and its villages, sixty towns in all. These were all descendants of Machir, the father of Gilead.
After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, his wife Abijah bore him Ashhur, the father of Tekoa.
Jerahmeel, Hezron's firstborn, had five sons: Ram the firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
Jerahmeel had another wife named Atarah, who was Onam's mother.
Ram, Jerahmeel's firstborn, had three sons: Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
Onam's sons were Shammai and Jada. Shammai's sons were Nadab and Abishur.
Abishur's wife was named Abihail. She bore him Ahban and Molid.
Nadab's sons were Seled and Appaim. Seled died without children.
Appaim's son was Ishi, Ishi's son was Sheshan, and Sheshan's descendant was Ahlai.
Jada, Shammai's brother, had two sons, Jether and Jonathan. Jether died without children.
Jonathan's sons were Peleth and Zaza. These were Jerahmeel's descendants.
Sheshan had daughters and no sons. He had an Egyptian servant named Jarha.
Sheshan gave his daughter to his servant Jarha in marriage, and she bore him Attai.
Attai was the father of Nathan, and Nathan was the father of Zabad.
Zabad was the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal was the father of Obed.
Obed was the father of Jehu, and Jehu was the father of Azariah.
Azariah was the father of Helez, and Helez was the father of Eleasah.
Eleasah was the father of Sismai, and Sismai was the father of Shallum.
Shallum was the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah was the father of Elishama.
Among the descendants of Caleb, Jerahmeel's brother, were his firstborn Mesha, the father of Ziph, and the sons of Mareshah, the father of Hebron.
Hebron's sons were Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
Shema was the father of Raham, who was the father of Jorkeam. Rekem was the father of Shammai.
Shammai's son was Maon, and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.
Caleb's concubine Ephah gave birth to Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran was also the father of Gazez.
Jahdai's sons were Regem, Jothan, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
Caleb's concubine Maacah gave birth to Sheber and Tirhanah.
She also bore Shaaph, the father of Madmannah, and Sheva, the father of Machbena and Gibea. Caleb's daughter was Achsah.
These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, Ephrathah's firstborn: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,
Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth Gader.
Shobal, the father of Kiriath Jearim, had these descendants: Haroeh and half the Menuhoth.
The families of Kiriath Jearim were the Ithrites, Puthites, Shumathites, and Mishraites. The Zorathites and Eshtaolites came from them.
Salma's descendants were Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, half the Manahathites, and the Zorites.
The families of scribes at Jabez were the Tirathites, Shimeathites, and Sucathites. They were the Kenites who descended from Hammath, the ancestor of Rechab's family.
